ety.text: * * (chocolate sprinkles): Unknown. There is much speculation that they were named after Jim Crow, but there is little, if any, evidence to support this theory.

senses.d: Sprinkles used as a topping for ice cream, cookies, or cupcakes.
ex: The crispy pastry tube was overflowing with sweetened, whipped ricotta and dotted with chocolate jimmies.

senses.d: A device used to circumvent a locking mechanism.
A jemmy; a crowbar used by burglars to open windows and doors.

ex: And then she said, "Gimme gimme gimme" / Jumped on my jimmy and rode me like the Wild West
From my Jimmy to my jaw / Every bone and every part of me's aching
We moved to the futon and started fooling around. He rolled on a jimmy and I sat on top of him.
"The next time you hook up with somebody," Lovie was saying, "you better wear a jimmy, boy. With spermicide on it. […]

senses.d: A male crab, especially a mature male; a cock. (Sometimes capitalized.)
ex: For quotations using this term, see Citations:Jimmy.

senses.d: To pry (something, especially a lock) open with or as if with a crowbar.
ex: The kitchen window had been jimmied.

grp.label: a device used to circumvent a locking mechanism
